acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce or bound the load-dependent blob-budget failure of TestSourceViewReverifiesHeadBeforeSuccess during a full cmd/corvint package run.
Make the test (or the budget it trips) deterministic under host load without weakening the head re-verification it asserts.
The test passes repeatedly inside a full -p 1 cmd/corvint run on a loaded host, with independent review.
body: Suspected flaky test, observed once on 2026-10-12 during a full `go test -p 1 -count=1 -timeout 30m ./cmd/corvint` run on darwin go1.27.2 (GOMAXPROCS=3, loaded host) in the V1-0632 closure-chain lane (branch claude/v1-0632-closure-chain, head 2368c382c82b87f76e1fc6a468d14334037ef7db, base 37ed36a46). That diff touches no source-view or handoff code. Actual: TestSourceViewReverifiesHeadBeforeSuccess (cmd/corvint/source_handoff_unix_test.go:29) failed with error code blob-budget. Expected: pass. Run alone it passed 3/3. Hypothesis (inference): a time- or load-sensitive budget in the source-view path is exceeded when the package runs under contention.
title: TestSourceViewReverifiesHeadBeforeSuccess fails with blob-budget under load (suspected flake)
